data_source.source_name: Google Maps - Places & Reviews (Timor-Leste tourist attractions)
data_source.api_status: SEIDAUK IHA API KEY. Google Places API presiza billing account, tanba ne'e grupu uza snapshot JSON husi scraper hanesan fonte dadus ba versaun ida-ne'e.
data_source.update_interval: Manual/periodiku - rekomenda re-koleta kada 7 loron (weekly batch). Sistema LA'OS real-time; bainhira API ho polling disponivel, troka deit `data_collection.load_raw_data()` ba fetch HTTP + interval 5 minutu (near-real-time) tuir Manual seksaun 5 nia nota.
data_source.unit_of_analysis: 1 baris = 1 review (komentariu turista) husi 1 lokal turizmu
data_source.terms_of_service_note: Dadus publiku (review anonimu, la inklui email/telefone/dadus pessoal sensivel). Naran reviewer mantein deit ba dedupe teknika no LA hatudu iha dashboard - tuir Manual seksaun 10: 'Evita kolekta informasaun pessoal ne'ebe la nesesariu'.
